distribution.name: AXM Local Game Hub
distribution.promise: One small local launcher, visible QR controllers, no account, no subscription and no internet requirement.

games.name: AXM Pong: Duet
games.description: A dark-glass 1-2 player Pong story with solo AI support, two-player co-op, three arenas, and local 1v1 multiplayer.
games.starterReason: Familiar Pong entry point for solo, two-player co-op or local 1v1 with phone controls.

games.name: AXM Pong: Cross
games.description: Three- or four-player dark-glass Pong with competitive last-light-standing and shared-core co-op across three arenas.
games.starterReason: Three- or four-player Pong with competitive and shared-core co-op modes plus QR phone seats.

games.name: Lumenwake
games.description: A polished 1–4 player co-op game-night run: carry fallen light, cover the carrier, revive the party and wake the aurora before the eclipse.
games.starterReason: Tiny cooperative game-night build with keyboard, touch and phone control.

games.name: Pulse Choir
games.status: PLAYABLE ALPHA V4 · HUMAN-STEWARDSHIP LOCAL GAME NIGHT
games.description: A 1–4 player cosmic co-op show: build risky three-note TRIADs, chain bank multipliers, synchronize a room-wide surge, and turn perfect harmony into glitch shields.
games.starterReason: Local cooperative rhythm game built around shared-screen play and QR controllers.
